sourceRefs.locator: Pleiades place 423025. Representative location of the ancient city in the published places CSV export; coordinates rounded to 0.01 degree.

processingNote.de: Stadt am Tiber. Der Punkt verortet das antike Rom und lässt die genaue Ausdehnung der Belagerung offen.
processingNote.en: City on the Tiber. The point locates ancient Rome and leaves the precise extent of the siege open.
